key_insight: Quantum knowledge distillation enables model compression and cross-architecture knowledge transfer, but reported benefits depend on the task and architecture.
engineering_relevance: Distillation may support circuit approximation, distributed learning, and classical deployment using quantum-derived supervision, but practical value requires resource-aware benchmarking.
method: Classify approaches by teacher–student configuration and the role of quantum resources.
Separate quantum-inspired methods from classically simulated and hardware-executed quantum methods.
Review transfer through measurement probabilities, expectation values, classical readouts, state overlaps, and circuit-level objectives.
evidence_signal: The surveyed studies report improvements, negligible gains, and degradation; physical-hardware evaluations remain limited and sometimes test only individual components.
watch_item: Heterogeneous evaluation protocols and incomplete resource reporting prevent general conclusions about practical quantum advantage.
paper_title: Quantum Knowledge Distillation: State-of-the-art, Applications and Open Problems
